endpoints.description: List certificates from the Venafi TPP WebSDK certificate inventory. Use Limit and Offset to page; CN/Issuer/ValidTo filters narrow the set. Read-only.

parameters.name: ValidToGreater
parameters.description: only certs expiring after this ISO-8601 date

parameters.name: ValidToLess
parameters.description: only certs expiring before this ISO-8601 date (find soon-to-expire certs)

parameters.name: OptionalFields
parameters.description: comma-separated extra fields to include, e.g. 'Thumbprint,ValidTo,Issuer'

endpoints.description: Get a single certificate's details by its GUID. Requires a guid — call venafi_list_certificates first to obtain one from a result row. Read-only.

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: the certificate GUID (braced, e.g. {xxxxxxxx-...}) — call venafi_list_certificates first to obtain one

endpoints.description: List prior issued versions of a certificate (renewal history). Requires a guid — call venafi_list_certificates first to obtain one. Read-only.

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: the certificate GUID — call venafi_list_certificates first to obtain one

endpoints.description: Get network validation results (chain, expiry, SSL/TLS health) for a certificate. Requires a guid — call venafi_list_certificates first to obtain one. Read-only.

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: the certificate GUID — call venafi_list_certificates first to obtain one
